summary: Join our training course on Quantitative Risk Models tailored for credit and risk managers. Elevate your expertise in risk analysis and decision-making.
lede: Quantitative Risk Models for Credit and Risk Managers equips professionals to turn complex credit data into practical insight for lending, provisioning, capital allocation, and portfolio strategy. The course develops skills in designing, interpreting, and validating models for probability of default, loss given default, exposure at default, and expected credit loss. Participants also learn to assess model outputs and communicate technical findings as clear, defensible, board-ready decisions. By combining mathematical precision with managerial judgment, the training supports stronger risk control and more resilient financial strategies in volatile conditions.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who quantify, analyze, or manage credit and portfolio risk, offering them advanced tools and insights to excel in their roles.
audience: Regulatory Compliance and Basel II/III Professionals
modules: Credit Risk Data and Model Inputs
Loss Given Default (LGD) and Exposure at Default (EAD) Models
Expected Credit Loss (ECL) and Portfolio Risk Measurement
Integrating Quantitative Risk Models into Decision-Making
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of financial risk management concepts and experience with data analysis tools such as Excel, R, or Python. Prior exposure to credit risk frameworks and regulatory standards is beneficial.
